steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool, peel and prick them with a fork.
Heat the oil, add the cumin and bay leaf, and let them sizzle.
Fry the chopped onion until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the ginger, garlic and green chilli and cook for a minute.
Add the chopped tomato with the spice powders and salt and cook until soft.
Turn the heat down, stir in the whisked curd and cook until oil shows at the edges.
Add the eggs and enough water to half cover them, then simmer covered for 8 minutes.
Finish with crushed kasuri methi and coriander leaves.
note: Two eggs a person, with the gravy scaled to match. The three sources used between 1 and 1.7 eggs a person, so the onion and tomato follow the two richer recipes.
